draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 10th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 3rd of 11 at QB. He went 3rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3,608 passing yards in 2023, 5th of 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New England Patriots. 30 career games and 29 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (18 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: completion % 72.0% (99th percentile), epa per dropback 0.31 (98th percentile), adj. net yards per attempt 8.26 (96th percentile). Weak spots: sacks taken 47 (9th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 4,394 passing yards against a median of 1,765, above the norm.
